draft_en.subject: An alternative to the EtherWAN / KONTEN industrial fibre switches you use
draft_en.body:
Hello Technosys team,

Over the past months you had a product mail from us - "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 20 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

As an alternative to the EtherWAN and KONTEN industrial fibre switches you use: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS - model STI-280GE - $46 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP version - STI-288GP - $59.8; industrial Gigabit media converter - STI-110GE - $26.5.

One question: do your projects require TEC/BIS-marked units, or is CE/RoHS acceptable?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
